"""SF20-20: reclaimed freight infrastructure; finite contributions, empty route.

Original Forge metres. glTF=(Blender x,z,-y). The carried and installed modules
are these same three source assets with unchanged scale and editable root pivots.
"""
import argparse, hashlib, json, math, sys
from pathlib import Path
import bpy, bmesh
from mathutils import Vector
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve(); ROOT=HERE.parents[4]
sys.path.insert(0,str(HERE.parent.parent))
import forge as F
import forge_export as E
REV='hundred-hand-mile-source-v4-native-prisms'
SOURCE=ROOT/'assets/ships/forge/sources/hundred_hand_mile'
COLORS={'paint':'#47575b','paint2':'#82715a','gunmetal':'#242e34','bare':'#78817c','glow_amber':'#bb792e'}
SPEC='design/program/world-depth-2026-10-02/references/sf20-2026-10-03/package/concepts/20_hundred_hand_mile.md'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def gltf(p):return [round(float(p[0]),6),round(float(p[2]),6),round(float(-p[1]),6)]
def hull(ps):
    ps=sorted(set((round(x,6),round(z,6)) for x,z in ps))
    def half(rows):
        r=[]
        for p in rows:
            while len(r)>1 and (r[-1][0]-r[-2][0])*(p[1]-r[-2][1])-(r[-1][1]-r[-2][1])*(p[0]-r[-2][0])<=1e-8:r.pop()
            r.append(p)
        return r
    return half(ps)[:-1]+half(ps[::-1])[:-1]
def bounds(ps):
    lo=[min(p[i] for p in ps) for i in range(3)];hi=[max(p[i] for p in ps) for i in range(3)]
    return dict(minGltf=lo,maxGltf=hi,sizeMetres=[round(b-a,6) for a,b in zip(lo,hi)])
def box(s,n,c,sz,m='gunmetal',bev=.1):return F.box(s,n,c,sz,material=m,bevel=bev,uv_scale=.35)
def ship(n):
    F.reset_scene();s=F.Ship(n,COLORS);s.collision_scale=1;return s

def mile():
    s=ship('hundred_hand_mile');parts={}
    for side in [-1,1]:
        x=side*80;k=len(s.objects)
        box(s,'PylonFoot'+str(side),(x,-32,-2),(17,16,4),'paint',.55)
        F.truss(s,'OldFreightTower'+str(side),(x,-32,0),(x,-32,18),7,4,'gunmetal',chord=.7,web=.36)
        for z in (1,9,17):box(s,'TowerCollar'+str(side)+str(z),(x,-32,z),(8,8,.6),'bare',.10)
        # Deliberately mismatched salvaged panels, fitted against the frame.
        box(s,'ReclaimedTowerSkin'+str(side),(x,-35.65,7),(6,.5,10),'paint2' if side==1 else 'paint',.12)
        box(s,'ShortPatch'+str(side),(x+side*2,-28.35,12),(2.4,.4,5),'paint2',.12)
        F.beams(s,'BrokenMount'+str(side),[((x,-32,18),(x-side*3,-32,20)),((x-side*3,-32,20),(x-side*5,-32,19.3))],.7,'bare',bevel=.08)
        parts['pylon_'+('a' if side<0 else 'b')]=s.objects[k:]
        s.socket('PYLON_'+('A' if side<0 else 'B'),(x,-32,0))
    # A supported low service bridge, wholly on one side of the freight lane.
    for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip([-72,-45,-15,15,45],[-45,-15,15,45,72])):
        k=len(s.objects);cx=(a+b)/2
        F.truss(s,'ServiceSpine'+str(i),(a,-32,-2),(b,-32,-2),3.2,3,'gunmetal',chord=.45,web=.25)
        box(s,'ServiceWalk'+str(i),(cx,-32,-.55),(b-a,7.2,1.1),'paint',.14)
        for j in range(3):
            px=a+(j+.5)*(b-a)/3
            box(s,'FittedReclaimedDeck%d_%d'%(i,j),(px,-32,.09),((b-a)/3-.25,6.4,.18),'paint2' if (i+j)%3==0 else 'paint',.035)
        parts['spine_'+str(i)]=s.objects[k:]
    # Receiver roots are exactly on the deck's nominal plane, not its top skin.
    for i,x in enumerate([-60,-30,0,30,60],1):
        k=len(s.objects)
        for y in (-35.4,-28.6):
            box(s,'ReceiverRail%d_%s'%(i,y),(x,y,.5),(12,.7,1),'bare',.08)
            for dx in (-5.7,5.7):box(s,'ReceiverStop%d_%s_%s'%(i,y,dx),(x+dx,y,1),( .6,.8,2),'gunmetal',.08)
        parts['receiver_'+str(i)]=s.objects[k:]
        s.socket('MODULE_SOCKET_%02d'%i,(x,-32,.2))
    # Eight modest solid lamps, each with its own welded foot and mast.
    lamps=[]
    for i,x in enumerate([-70,-50,-30,-10,10,30,50,70]):
        z=3.5+(i%2)*1.0
        box(s,'LampFoot'+str(i),(x,-35.05,.45),(1.1,1.1,.6),'bare',.08)
        F.beams(s,'SupportedLampMast'+str(i),[((x,-35.2,.5),(x,-35.2,z)),((x,-35.2,z),(x,-33.8,z))],.22,'gunmetal',bevel=.035)
        box(s,'LampHood'+str(i),(x,-33.8,z),(1.2,1.0,.6),'gunmetal',.12)
        lamps.append(box(s,'AmberLampLens'+str(i),(x,-33.8,z+.32),(.72,.52,.10),'glow_amber',.025))
    s.hook_part('HOOK_HUNDRED_HAND_LAMPS',*lamps)
    # The record is an existing fixture; history appears in the inspector.
    box(s,'ServiceTerminalPedestal',(59,-32,1.2),(1.4,1.8,2),'gunmetal',.18)
    box(s,'ServiceTerminalHousing',(59,-32,2.6),(3.4,2.6,1),'paint2',.20)
    screen=box(s,'RecordTerminalScreen',(59,-32,3.13),(2.6,1.7,.08),'glow_amber',.025)
    s.hook_part('HOOK_HUNDRED_HAND_RECORD',screen)
    for x in (62,63,64):box(s,'AbstractServiceTally'+str(x),(x,-32,.28),(.40,2.6,.18),'bare',.035)
    s.socket('SOCKET_Record',(59,-32,3.2));s.socket('SOCKET_Camera_Focus',(0,-32,0))
    return s,parts

def power():
    s=ship('hundred_hand_power');k=len(s.objects)
    box(s,'RecoveredGeneratorSkid',(0,0,.45),(10,5.8,.9),'gunmetal',.15)
    box(s,'GeneratorBlock',(0,0,2.1),(7.8,4.5,3.1),'paint',.32)
    for x in (-3.8,3.8):
        box(s,'GeneratorEndGuard'+str(x),(x,0,2),( .6,5,3.2),'bare',.13)
    for y in (-1.5,1.5):
        F.cylinder(s,'LongCapacitor'+str(y),(-2.8,y,4),(2.8,y,4),.62,material='gunmetal',segments=20,bevel=.06)
        for x in (-2,2):F.ring(s,'CapacitorClamp'+str(x)+str(y),(x,y,4),.65,.10,material='bare',segments=16,sides=6)
    for x in (-2.5,-1.5,-.5,.5,1.5,2.5):box(s,'CoolingFin'+str(x),(x,0,3.75),(.18,1.2,.5),'bare',.035)
    F.beams(s,'GeneratorTowEye',[((-5,-.7,.5),(-5.7,-.7,.5)),((-5.7,-.7,.5),(-5.7,.7,.5)),((-5.7,.7,.5),(-5,.7,.5))],.22,'bare',bevel=.035)
    s.socket('SOCKET_Tether_Massline',(-5.7,0,.5));s.socket('SOCKET_Install_Pivot',(0,0,0))
    return s,{'power_body':s.objects[k:]}

def guide():
    s=ship('hundred_hand_guide');parts={}
    for i,(a,b) in enumerate([((-5,0,.8),(0,.8,.8)),((0,.8,.8),(5,0,.8))]):
        k=len(s.objects);F.beams(s,'RecoveredSwitchyardGuide'+str(i),[(a,b)],1.2,'paint2',h=1.6,bevel=.1)
        for x,y,z in (a,b):box(s,'GuideFoot%d_%s'%(i,x),(x,y,.25),(1.4,1.8,.5),'gunmetal',.08)
        parts['guide_segment_'+str(i)]=s.objects[k:]
    # Retained tow lug is physically connected at the bent elbow.
    tow_start=len(s.objects)
    F.beams(s,'GuideTowEye',[((-.7,.8,1.4),(-.7,1.8,1.4)),((-.7,1.8,1.4),(.7,1.8,1.4)),((.7,1.8,1.4),(.7,.8,1.4))],.18,'gunmetal',bevel=.025)
    parts['guide_segment_0']+=s.objects[tow_start:]
    s.socket('SOCKET_Tether_Massline',(0,1.8,1.4));s.socket('SOCKET_Install_Pivot',(0,0,0))
    return s,parts

def cargo():
    s=ship('hundred_hand_cargo');k=len(s.objects)
    box(s,'FiniteContributionPallet',(0,0,.35),(9,5.8,.7),'gunmetal',.13)
    for x in (-2.2,2.2):
        box(s,'RecoverableFreightBox'+str(x),(x,0,1.75),(3.8,4.8,2.8),'paint2',.22)
        for y in (-2.35,2.35):box(s,'FreightFrame'+str(x)+str(y),(x,y,1.75),(3.9,.18,2.9),'gunmetal',.045)
        for dx in (-1.1,1.1):box(s,'PalletBand'+str(x)+str(dx),(x+dx,0,3.18),(.18,4.7,.15),'bare',.025)
    F.beams(s,'CargoTowEye',[((-4.5,-.5,.4),(-5,-.5,.4)),((-5,-.5,.4),(-5,.5,.4)),((-5,.5,.4),(-4.5,.5,.4))],.18,'bare',bevel=.025)
    s.socket('SOCKET_Tether_Massline',(-5,0,.4));s.socket('SOCKET_Install_Pivot',(0,0,0))
    return s,{'cargo_body':s.objects[k:]}

def exact_collision(s,root,obs):
    """Author the existing native Y-extruded XZ collision solid explicitly.

    Preserve the projection and extrema of v3's complete source hull. This is
    a non-render physics helper, not a claim that visible mesh is an extrusion.
    """
    from scipy.spatial import ConvexHull
    points=[tuple(o.matrix_world@v.co) for o in obs for v in o.data.vertices]
    full=ConvexHull(points)
    used=sorted(set(int(i) for tri in full.simplices for i in tri))
    measured=[gltf(points[i]) for i in used]
    polygon=hull([(p[0],p[2]) for p in measured])
    min_y=min(p[1] for p in measured);max_y=max(p[1] for p in measured)
    vertices=[(x,-z,y) for y in (min_y,max_y) for x,z in polygon]
    n=len(polygon)
    faces=[tuple(range(n-1,-1,-1)),tuple(range(n,2*n))]
    faces += [(i,(i+1)%n,(i+1)%n+n,i+n) for i in range(n)]
    mesh=bpy.data.meshes.new('NativeSourcePrism')
    mesh.from_pydata(vertices,[],faces)
    bm=bmesh.new();bm.from_mesh(mesh)
    bmesh.ops.triangulate(bm,faces=list(bm.faces))
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm,faces=list(bm.faces));bm.to_mesh(mesh);bm.free()
    ob=bpy.data.objects.new('COLLISION',mesh);bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(ob)
    ob.parent=root;ob['collision']=True;ob['nonRender']=True;ob.hide_render=True
    ob['collisionRepresentation']='native-y-extruded-xz-prism'
    return ob

def export(build):
    s,assemblies=build();s.socket_names=set(s.sockets);s.finish()
    out=SOURCE/s.id;out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    E._rename_materials(s);aid='SF_PLACE_HUNDRED_HAND_MILE' if s.id=='hundred_hand_mile' else 'SF_PROP_'+s.id.upper()
    root=E._root_empty(aid+'_ROOT',{'nativeRigidRoot':True});E._add_sockets(s,root)
    components=[]
    for name,obs in assemblies.items():
        ob=exact_collision(s,root,obs);ob.name='COLLISION_'+name.upper();ob.data.name=ob.name
        ps=[gltf(ob.matrix_world@v.co) for v in ob.data.vertices];bound=bounds(ps)
        components.append(dict(id=name,node=ob.name,kind='convex',sourceObjects=[o.name for o in obs],verticesGltf=ps,triangles=[list(p.vertices) for p in ob.data.polygons],bounds=bound,nativeProjection=dict(schema='spaceface.nativeConvexXZ.v1',points=hull([(p[0],p[2]) for p in ps]),minY=bound['minGltf'][1],maxY=bound['maxGltf'][1],scale=1)))
    tiers={}
    for lod in range(3):
        obs=E._lod_meshes(s,lod,'LOD'+str(lod))
        for o in obs:
            o.parent=root
            # Decimation cannot retain interpolated bevel normals across faces.
            if lod:
                E._select_only([o]);bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=o
                if o.data.has_custom_normals:bpy.ops.mesh.customdata_custom_splitnormals_clear()
                for p in o.data.polygons:p.use_smooth=False
        path=out/(s.id+('' if lod==0 else '_lod'+str(lod))+'.glb')
        E._export([root]+list(root.children_recursive),str(path))
        E._stamp(str(path),dict(assetId=aid,partId=s.id.replace('_','-'),liveId=s.id,slot='place',category='wholeships',forge=dict(version=1,ship=s.id),geometryRevision=REV,authoringSourceSha256=sha(HERE)), 'lod'+str(lod))
        def annotate(doc):
            doc['asset'].setdefault('extras',{})['conceptGeometry']=dict(schema='spaceface.conceptSourceGeometry.v1',renderScale=1,geometryRevision=REV,authoringSourcePath=str(HERE.relative_to(ROOT)),recipeSha256=sha(HERE),collisionRepresentation='native-y-extruded-xz-prism',nativeRepresentation='same-authored-prism',negativeSpace=['All local |Z|<20 clear','Original bypass at local Z=-100 clear'])
        E.patch_glb_json(str(path),annotate)
        tiers[str(lod)]=dict(file=path.name,sha256=sha(path),bytes=path.stat().st_size,triangles=sum(len(p.vertices)-2 for o in obs for p in o.data.polygons),drawPrimitives=len(obs),bounds=bounds([gltf(o.matrix_world@v.co) for o in obs for v in o.data.vertices]))
        E._clear_export_objects(obs)
    for o in s.objects:o.parent=root
    for o in root.children_recursive:o.hide_render=o.name.startswith('COLLISION')
    bpy.context.preferences.filepaths.save_version=0;bpy.ops.file.pack_all();bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=str(out/(s.id+'.blend')))
    data=dict(schema='spaceface.conceptSourceGeometry.v1',assetId=aid,family=s.id,geometryRevision=REV,renderScale=1,sourceAxes='+X nose,+Y port,+Z up',gltfMapping='x,z,-y',sourceBinding=dict(authoringSourcePath=str(HERE.relative_to(ROOT)),authoringSourceSha256=sha(HERE),collisionPartIdentity='node-name'),authoringSourceSha256=sha(HERE),sourceInputs=[dict(path=str(p.relative_to(ROOT)),sha256=sha(p)) for p in (HERE,HERE.parent.parent/'forge.py',HERE.parent.parent/'forge_export.py')],sourceBlendSha256=sha(out/(s.id+'.blend')),lods=tiers,bounds=tiers['0']['bounds'],collision=dict(kind='compound',components=components),sockets={name:dict(positionGltf=gltf(p),forwardGltf=gltf(f)) for name,(p,f) in s.sockets.items()},preflight=dict(idea='Reclaimed tools make ordinary traffic',authority=[SPEC],values='dark trusses; blue-grey skin; mismatched ochre panels; small supported amber lights',supportedViews=['top','chase','detail']),provenance='Original Forge geometry; carried and installed modules use identical source at scale 1')
    (out/'measured-contract.json').write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n');return data

def main():
    SOURCE.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    models={k:export(b) for k,b in [('mile',mile),('power',power),('guide',guide),('cargo',cargo)]}
    data=dict(schemaVersion=1,geometryRevision=REV,routeId='tethys:hundred-hand-mile:v1',center=[100,2050],scale=1,models=models,moduleSockets=[dict(id='MODULE_SOCKET_%02d'%(i+1),positionGltf=[x,.2,32]) for i,x in enumerate([-60,-30,0,30,60])],lampCount=8,hooks=dict(lamps='HOOK_HUNDRED_HAND_LAMPS',record='HOOK_HUNDRED_HAND_RECORD'),negativeSpace=dict(laneHalfWidth=20,bypassZ=-100),lods={str(i):dict(triangles=sum(m['lods'][str(i)]['triangles'] for m in models.values()),drawPrimitives=sum(m['lods'][str(i)]['drawPrimitives'] for m in models.values())) for i in range(3)})
    (SOURCE/'measured-contract.json').write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n');print('HUNDRED_HAND_SOURCE',json.dumps(data['lods']))
if __name__=='__main__':main()
